objectives.description: Create test-lean-comparator-run.sh: verdict classification cases, comparator_unavailable cases, guard routing cases, anti-vacuous/mutation cases, skip-with-report for real-binary-dependent cases

approaches_tried.approach: local name="$1" dir="$WORKDIR/repo-$name" on one local statement
approaches_tried.reason: under set -u, bash expands all word values on a local statement before any of the names become visible to later words in the SAME statement, so $name in the second assignment referenced the (unset) outer/global name, not the just-assigned $1. Split into two separate local statements.

approaches_tried.approach: returning captured tool output via a function's own stdout (command-substituted by the caller) while the same function also calls pass()/fail() which echo to stdout
approaches_tried.reason: capturing the function's stdout via $(...) to grab the tool output also silently swallowed the pass()/fail() announcements for every case redirected to /dev/null, making 8 of the 11 verdict cases invisible in suite output despite passing. Fixed by returning the captured output through a global LAST_CASE_OUTPUT variable instead.
